Grateful to be a small part of this journey. 💙

name: Abhiraj Deshmukh
story:
Joining Icebrkr has been one of the most exciting learning experiences for me. As the AI/ML Lead, I’ve had the opportunity to work on challenging problems involving AI models, embeddings, intelligent routing, and proactive AI systems. What makes Icebrkr different is that we’re not just building another chatbot we’re building an AI companion that is useful, privacy-focused, and designed to genuinely help people in their daily lives.
What excites me the most is the vision behind Icebrkr and the freedom to innovate. Every day brings new challenges and opportunities to build something meaningful alongside an amazing team. I’m proud to be part of this journey and look forward to seeing Icebrkr grow into a product that people rely on every day.

name: Ananya Agrawal
story:
As an AI-ML intern, icebrkr is a dream project. We aren't just building another wrapper app; we’re architecting an entirely independent, privacy-first AI ecosystem. What makes me most excited to use IB COMPASS is the sheer seamlessness of running localized models entirely on-device.
IB proves that the next generation of AI doesn't need to harvest your personal data to be profoundly useful. Seeing our vision of an offline, autonomous assistant come to life makes me incredibly proud to be part of this team!
